phaseCaption: From the first hello to the next journey.
supportText: One workspace. Every agency. A little more possibility.
welcomeSub: Bring your agencies, people, and conversations together.
setupSub: A few small steps to get your workspace ready.
stepOneSub: Your home for people and conversations.
stepTwoSub: Give the right people the right access.
stepThreeSub: Bring in an existing business number.
stepFourSub: Check that messages reach the right agency.
networkSub: A clear view of the people you work with.
activitySub: The latest changes in your workspace.
noActivitySub: Agency and team updates will appear as you get set up.
nextText: Open the inbox to reply to customers and keep track of their travel requests.
agenciesSub: Each agency has its own team, numbers, and private conversations.
emptyAgenciesSub: Add your first agency to start building your network.
teamTitle: Good journeys start with good teams.
teamSub: Invite your people and keep access scoped to the right agency.
roleHelp: Administrators manage the team and connections. Agents can reply and update customer details. Viewers have read-only access.
connectionSub: Connect existing WhatsApp Business Platform numbers to their agencies.
noConnections: Your next conversation is one connection away
noConnectionsSub: Add a WhatsApp Business Platform number, then configure the webhook in Meta.
webhookHelp: In your Meta app, configure this callback and subscribe to the messages field. For an existing integration, review its current callback before changing it.
connectionNote: Credentials are encrypted. Numbers are verified with Meta before they can be saved. Real messages appear only after webhook setup.
settingsTitle: The details that make it yours.
settingsSub: Your profile, preferences, and workspace foundation.
languageHelp: Arabic and Sorani use right-to-left layouts. This does not change a customer’s preferred language.
securityText: Staff only see agencies they belong to. WhatsApp credentials are encrypted, and incoming events require a valid Meta signature.
scopeText: Agency workspaces, team access, WhatsApp inboxes, text replies, customer details, inquiry status, and private notes. AI and campaigns come later.
demoNotice: You’re exploring sample data. Try the inbox, or sign in for your real agencies.
demoReadOnly: This is a read-only tour. Sign in to make changes.
name: Full name
signInSub: Your agencies. Your people. All in one place.
signInFoot: Access is by invitation. Ask your workspace administrator for an invite.
signInError: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details and try again.
heroText: A thoughtful workspace for travel agencies. Bring your team together and give every conversation a place to begin.
heroFooter: From the first hello to the next great journey.
inviteSub: Create your account to join the agency that invited you.
inviteSuccess: You’re in. Sign in with your email and password to continue.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Example: zagros-travel
inviteHelp: This creates a private, single-use link that expires in 48 hours. Share it with your teammate through your usual channel.
inviteLinkHelp: Copy this link now. It won’t be shown again after closing.
metaHelp: Use the existing agency’s Cloud API credentials. Get the IDs from Meta Business settings. These secrets are never shown to other team members.

errors.invalidOrigin: Refresh the page and try again.

passwordChangeError: Password update failed. Check your current password and try again.

crm.sampleHint: Try replies and edits. Sample changes reset when you leave this inbox.
crm.privateHint: Conversations stay private to this agency.
crm.noAgency: Add an agency to open its inbox.
crm.emptyHint: Incoming WhatsApp messages will appear here once a number is connected.
crm.searchHint: Try a different search or status.
crm.chooseConversation: Every journey starts with a hello.
crm.chooseHint: Select a conversation to view the messages and customer details.
crm.recentMessages: Latest 100 messages · refresh to check for updates

crm.uncertainHelp: Sending could not be confirmed. Check WhatsApp before sending again.

crm.viewerHint: You have view-only access to this inbox.

crm.detailsHint: One simple record for this conversation.
crm.noteHint: Only your agency can see this. It is not sent to the customer.

inboxSub: Read, reply, and keep the travel details together.
